method: Semantic units were hand-bounded from public cockpit/ATC recordings using the word-onset offsets in their automatic-caption tracks. The measurements describe relative pace inside a packet; they are not treated as authoritative transcripts.
limitations: Receiver squelch, overlapping speakers, automatic-caption substitutions, and the lack of word-end timestamps make every boundary approximate. The final word end is extrapolated from the neighboring onset interval. Use these results to reject flat or theatrical timing, not to imitate a recording frame-for-frame.

source.title: Full AT-38 sortie with cockpit and ATC audio

packets.timingBasis: YouTube automatic-caption token onsets at 3136.800, +0.319, +0.559, +0.799 and +1.039 seconds. The caption substitutes 'check' in the gear phrase; semantic labels are analyst interpretation.
